$description: Geez Design Tokens — machine-readable source of truth. Canonical values only. For the full type scale and Spoof font base64, see geez-brand-repository.html and the Figma source (file key jK2ao1ub8VTVlKMOCwDiyG). Never introduce a value not present here.

green.$description: Geez Green. Brand identity, highlights, success. LIGHT color — never place white or light text on it. Use black text.

magenta.$description: Magenta. Primary actions, CTAs, links. DARK color — use white text on it.

color.$rule: FOUR COLORS ONLY. No new color values, ever. No gray scale — depth is achieved with the four colors and opacity.

heartbeat.$description: The Geez heartbeat. ALL screen transitions use this duration. Non-negotiable.
cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1). Paired with the 936ms duration on every transition.

base.$description: Base spacing unit. All spacing is a multiple of 4px.

stroke.$description: Canonical stroke width. Exact — do not round.

radius.$description: Canonical corner radius. Exact — do not round.

pill-stroke.$description: Pill stroke width. EXACT — never rounded to 2px. Rounding = conformance violation.

family.$description: Spoof is the ONLY permitted typeface. 6 weights, base64 woff2, zero external font dependencies. Font base64 lives in geez-brand-repository.html as @font-face blocks. Extraction note: match data:font/truetype MIME type (woff2 query returns zero results even though fonts are present).

weights.$description: Six locked Spoof weights. Exact numeric weights + full type scale (display / heading / body / label / caption) are defined in geez-brand-repository.html and the Figma source of truth (jK2ao1ub8VTVlKMOCwDiyG). Body copy default: Spoof Light 300.

scale.$description: Hierarchy only — px values live in the Brand Repository HTML + Figma.
scale.display: Hero moments only — full-screen empty states, onboarding.
scale.heading: Section titles, screen headers.
scale.label: Buttons, nav, badges, form labels. Uppercase at small sizes.
scale.caption: Metadata, timestamps, helper text.

atelier-top.$description: Atelier artifact standard: 6px Geez Green top border on white background.
